title: #038. Graph Coloring with Symmetry Breaking
subtitle: Assign integer colors to graph vertices so adjacent vertices differ, breaking color-permutation symmetry to minimize colors used.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { colors, usedColors }.
judge.m3: Adjacent vertices {p0} and {p1} share the same color ({p2}).
judge.m4: Reported usedColors ({p0}) does not match number of distinct colors used ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid coloring, but usedColors ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
